description: WATI approved template messages used by EDMS. These are one-way business-initiated messages (not interactive flows).

templates.name: edms_otp
templates.purpose: Send OTP during website registration (/register page)
templates.trigger: User clicks 'Send OTP' on website registration form
templates.notes: OTP is valid for 10 minutes. Max 5 attempts. 60s cooldown between resends.

templates.name: edms_login_v1
templates.purpose: Send login credentials after successful registration (web or WhatsApp)
templates.trigger: After account creation — web registration complete or WhatsApp flow submit
templates.notes: Sent as backup after registration. Primary credential delivery is via Meta Cloud API for WhatsApp registrations.
